|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Blown Clear (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-19-Blown_Clear-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Blown Clear (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Blown Clear (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on table. May place an Imperial Council Member here from hand. Once per turn, if a logistics agenda or admiral here, may subtract X from a starship’s forfeit and immunity to attrition for remainder of turn, where X = total influence at Conference Room.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Blown Clear (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “a logistics agenda or admiral” to “an admiral or logistics agenda”: “Deploy on table. May place an Imperial Council Member here from hand. Once per turn, if an admiral or logistics agenda here, may subtract X from a starship's forfeit and immunity to attrition for remainder of turn, where X = total influence at Conference Room.”.<ref name="cl-1240_21-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
